Home - The Railway Sleeper Lodge, Bed and Breakfast in Colchester
Credit Cards Accepted
Family Room Available
Free Parking
Pet Friendly Room
Railway Sleeper Lodge offers clean, compact and great‑value accommodation just a 5‑minute walk from Colchester Main Train Station. Designed for budget‑conscious travellers, our small but well‑equipped rooms provide everything you need for a comfortable and convenient stay at an affordable price.Our rooms are ideal for short stays, contractors, solo travellers and anyone seeking reliable comfort without the cost of larger hotel rooms.
• 24-hour self check-in for maximum convenience
• Ensuite rooms with microwave, fridge, and hospitality tray
• Free unlimited Wi-Fi and Freeview TV
• Hairdryer, iron, and ironing board in every room
• Free on-site parking
• Pet Friendly
Colchester city centre is just a 5‑minute drive away, with Colchester Zoo, Colchester Castle and major road links (A12/A120) easily accessible. Whether visiting for work or leisure, Railway Sleeper Lodge is a smart choice for travellers who want value, convenience and a well‑equipped compact room.

Room Information - The Railway Sleeper Lodge, Bed and Breakfast in Colchester
Room Information
The Railway Sleeper Lodge
Room Information
Our rooms are compact but well equipped making us the perfect budget place to stay.
Every Room includes
· Comfy beds with 10.5 tog duvet, 4 pillows for double beds 2 pillows for single beds
· towels
· Ensuite bathrooms with powerful power showers & complimentary hand, hair & body wash
· Small desk area
· Mini fridge, microwave (with bowls and spoons only ideal for grab and go food) and hospitality tray
· Hairdryers & irons
· Solid floor in all rooms (no carpets)
· FREE unlimited Wi-Fi
Please note we have steep stairs and our rooms are small so may not suit everyone or those with mobility problems. Bergholt Road is a busy road and rooms at the front will be affected by traffic noise during the day.
